While I don't doubt the findings, I do dislike the explanation.

There is no need to invoke evolution at such a high level, the simple fact that men and women have different attributes would make it an economic truism that mixed-sex couples require different things from one another to maximise utility. Since we can differentiate men and women by certain traits and desires in any event it would be highly surprising if we could not identify complimentary traits that they might seek.

So the only thing that evolution would need to explain is that people are naturally utility seeking (or maximising) and everything else comes along for free. This would also come with the bonus of explaining why homosexuals would take on pseudo-gendered roles in relationships and that females are not always the primary care-givers in nature, both things that an evolutionary explanation at this level would presumably have great difficulty with.

I don't understand why it matters that they chose evolution as a reason. I mean, if we're dealing with things that change overtime wouldn't that mean we should apply theories that have groundwork relating to consecutive offspring evolving over time?

As for why it can explain it: such roles are actually beneficial as those not adapting to those roles would find life hard. For example, a woman that finds broke men attractive would quickly be unable to fed her offspring and they would die of starvation. That is an evolutionary explanation and there's no difficulty in using it.

You're not supposed to use evolution to "explain" things in this way, it is one of the key features of Darwinism that evolutionary psychologists love to flout.

We don't have noses shaped the way they are to rest our glasses on, we rest our glasses on our noses because they are the shape they are.

Darwinian evolution is not a reason for anything, it is just a mechanism. A particular car isn't the reason we go to work, and work isn't the reason we want food, money, shelter or sex. We don't want sex because we evolved to do so, we want sex because wanting sex made us evolve. Similarly, we don't want different traits in partners because of evolutionary pressures pushes us into that behaviour. Rather, our selective breeding behaviour pushes us into successfully making babies that want to do the same, allowing the process of evolution to happen.

And why does it allow evolution to happen? Because it maximises utility.
